_comment: Golden baseline for the Kokoro fixture (ops-11; content fields added by ops-45 / #1911). Re-bless after editing fixture.json or an intentional Kokoro weights upgrade: `npm run test:golden-audio -- --bless` on a box with the weights, then commit. `metadata` records the weights SHA + kokoro-onnx version so a model bump is legible (a sample-count mismatch then explains 'you upgraded the model'). Each entry is sample-count/duration (asserted within `tolerance`) plus, since #1911, `transcript` (the recorded Whisper output -- the content-drift reference, asserted at tolerance 0) and `text_edits` (that transcript's edit distance from fixture.json's `text`, used as the re-bless cap: a later bless may not exceed `text_edits + 1`). A bless that would silently overwrite a DIFFERING `transcript` is refused unless GOLDEN_REBLESS_CONTENT=1 is also set -- see compare.bless_guard.
